description: Demo rooms in 406 (real robot run6, 윤동건 2026-11-03), as the team drew them (이성민 2026-11-04): rooms 1 (west, below c), 2 (east, below d), 3 (north-east, right of b), and the passage from the start between them; the part south of partition f is not in the task. Map coordinates [m] on 406_new (origin -7.6534, -13.4436, 0.05 m). Partitions a-f stand in 406_new (1.0-1.6 m tall, below the wall band), so their occupied cells inside the boxes are room-map walls. Doors close the open passages between the rooms and the passage for room segmentation only, from partition end to partition end (ends measured on 406_new). No partitions are added: navigation loads 406_new.yaml itself (same map version as motion).
